subject: mathematics
content:
The angle of elevation of the top of a vertical tower standing on a horizontal plane is observed to be 45<sup>o</sup> from
a point A on the plane. Let B be the point 30 m vertically above the point A. If the angle of elevation of the
top of the tower from B be 30<sup>o</sup>, then the distance (in m) of the foot of the tower from the point A is :
